Data.description: Final output Shapefile combining Voronoi polygons with building overlay analysis. Contains 55 Voronoi polygons enriched with: building_count (number of buildings whose centroids fall within the cell), building_area (total intersection area of building footprints with the cell), and building_ids (comma-separated list of building identifiers). All 55 buildings were successfully matched to their Voronoi cells. CRS inherited from input (undefined/projected).

Shapefile containing 55 bounded Voronoi (Tyson) polygons generated from building centroids. Each polygon represents the region of space closest to a given building. All polygons are bounded via clipping to a 10%-expanded envelope of the point extent. Attributes: voronoi_id (unique polygon identifier). CRS inherited from input (undefined/projected).
